wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos8-armst.name: James Armstrong
wa-pierce-2026-district-court-pos8-armst.bio: Former Presiding Judge of Bremerton Municipal Court and judge pro tem, U.S. Marine Corps veteran, and attorney who represented injured workers and people seeking disability benefits.

wa-pierce-2026-tacoma-muni-pos1-sonntag-.name: Dee Sonntag
wa-pierce-2026-tacoma-muni-pos1-sonntag-.bio: Tacoma Municipal Court judge in Department 1, entering her fourth year on the bench.

wa-pierce-2026-tacoma-muni-pos2-flores-s.name: Sergio C. Flores
wa-pierce-2026-tacoma-muni-pos2-flores-s.bio: Tacoma Municipal Court judge appointed by the Tacoma City Council in January 2026; former City Prosecuting Attorney.

positions.stance: "My judicial philosophy is one of collaboration, compassion, and accountability."
Plans "to respond to local crime through effective diversion and therapeutic programs," saying this approach addresses victims' concerns and offenders' struggles while reducing recidivism.
Says community courts, done right, "address the root cause of participants' struggles and provide services in a supportive and structured environment."

md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-adams-eliza.name: Elizabeth Adams
md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-adams-eliza.bio: Attorney with more than 25 years of practice, including the Maryland Office of the Attorney General and the Anne Arundel County State's Attorney's Office.

md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-butcher-sid.name: Sidney A. Butcher
md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-butcher-sid.bio: Associate Judge of the Anne Arundel County Circuit Court since December 2025; former District Court judge, Assistant Attorney General, and Baltimore City Assistant State's Attorney.

md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-jackson-ste.name: Ginina A. Jackson-Stevenson
md-anne-arundel-2026-circuit-jackson-ste.bio: Anne Arundel County Circuit Court judge since December 2023; former family law magistrate, solo practitioner, and Assistant Public Defender.

mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-13-stennes.name: Stacy Stennes
mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-13-stennes.bio: Ramsey County District Court judge appointed in 2024; previously spent 15 years in private practice handling complex civil litigation.

mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-15-vuelo-s.name: Sophia Vuelo
mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-15-vuelo-s.bio: Ramsey County District Court judge since 2017; former solo practitioner, special assistant Ramsey County Attorney, assistant public defender, and assistant city attorney.

mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-24-iyer-ve.name: Veena Iyer
mn-ramsey-2026-district-court-24-iyer-ve.bio: Ramsey County District Court judge; previously executive director of a legal assistance organization serving new Americans, legal aid attorney, and employment lawyer.
